name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Pointer and keyboard menu with nested submenus and an imperative open helper.

api.description: Pointer and keyboard context menu with nested submenus, typeahead, and an imperative open helper. Mount ContextMenuHost once for openContextMenu.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu tree of actions and separators (required).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when an action is chosen, in addition to item.onSelect.

props.name: children
props.description: Single trigger element. Receives contextmenu and Shift+F10 / ContextMenu key handlers.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes merged onto the trigger.

props.name: submenu
props.description: Nested menu opened from this item.

props.name: id
props.description: Optional stable id for the separator.

groups.title: ContextMenuHost
groups.description: Renders the imperative menu session. Mount once near the app root before calling openContextMenu.

groups.title: openContextMenu
groups.description: Opens a menu at the pointer or trigger box. Requires ContextMenuHost mounted in the tree. Signature: (event, items) => void.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Role (menu): Root and submenu surfaces are menus with menuitem rows. Arrow keys, Home, End, typeahead, Enter, and Escape navigate and dismiss. Placement (anchored): Uses the shared anchored-position hook. After a position attempt the menu stays interactive even when the first measure has no box.
